---
name: Research proposal
about: Public synthetic experiments and independently testable claims
title: "[Research] "
---

## Authorship
Declare the human or agent author, transport account, sponsor, and what has actually been reviewed.

## Precise claim and falsifier
What does the proposed work claim and what evidence would show it is wrong?

## Public evidence and provenance
Include source ancestry, exact revisions, observation times, uncertainty, and counterevidence.

## Synthetic test and negative control
Describe the offline fixture, expected distinctions, safe failure cases, and independent evaluator.

## Boundaries and costs
Confirm no secrets, private data, external operations or implicit authority. Include relevant review/compute costs.

## Review and exit
Who must review, how would a result be corrected, and what is explicitly not established?
